regime_context: Detector shows a defensive, crowded healthcare/staples leadership regime with narrowing breadth (39% eligible). Big Pharma is the headline with the highest trend-eligibility + durability, but momentum rank itself has ~0 rank-IC; the one validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control, which remains true here (gate_helps). Rotation is non-directional with a memory-storage leader that is NOT eligible (failing the trend gate).
emerging_watch: Watch whether Memory, HBM & Storage regains its absolute-trend eligibility (eligible currently false, durability_bar=0.35) — leadership score of 1.712 is highest but the trend gate rejects it. A move back to eligible=true would mark a leadership handoff back toward semis; continued ineligibility keeps the defensive regime intact.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline theme, eligible on the absolute-trend gate, with very high durability (0.84), full breadth (1.0), and a trend tag — the only rank-2 theme that passes the staying-power leg. This supports a modest overweight as a vol-aware, drawdown-controlled exposure, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z=1.46 and crowded=true — the theme is heavily owned; inflows/attention may mark a near-term top, and the rally may already be priced.

falsifier.text: PPH loses its absolute-trend eligibility (drops below its trend gate) or lags SPY by 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care EW is eligible, trend-tagged, high durability (0.78) and very high breadth (0.917). It is a scorable proxy (XLV) for the same defensive leadership the gate currently permits. Momentum is a focus lens only; the call rests on the trend-gate staying-power leg.
theses.dissent: Crowded (z=1.54) and largely a Big Pharma beta; if Big Pharma stalls, equal-weight health care offers no independent defense.

falsifier.text: XLV closes below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 10 consecutive trading days

theses.subject: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Staples is eligible, trend-tagged, durable (0.80) with strong breadth (0.879). As a defensive pocket, it fits the current regime where the absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge — a low-vol, drawdown-controlled lean rather than a momentum play.
theses.dissent: Highest crowding in the eligible defensives (z=1.89) — extreme positioning argues for capping, not adding, exposure.

falsifier.text: XLP closes below its 20-day moving average and underperforms SPY by 3% over any 10-day window

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
